page_note: Pristine cosmological substrate page. Two enumerations: (1) five attributes of the sun (light, beauty, peace, life of living soul, power) each mapped to a cosmic effect — the sun is read as a correspondence-image of the Father of Greatness; (2) three further types revealed in the sun mapping to the mystery of the first Greatness. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The "ecclesial drift" flagged in the fatigue score is a false positive triggered by ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ and ⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ functioning here as substrate vocabulary (mystery of the Father of Greatness), not ecclesial markers. Brief demonstrative "you yourselves see" at seg 12 is internal to the teaching's comparative move (sun's light vs. all created lights), not exhortation.
